data.name: DisplayNameHelper
data.value: This name will appear on every entry of the change log.

data.name: UserNameHelper
data.value: Unique across the installation and cannot be changed afterwards.

data.name: NewPasswordHelper
data.value: Leave empty to keep the current one.

data.name: AdministratorHelper
data.value: Without this right the user cannot create or change accounts; everything else is governed by the permissions below.

data.name: RoleHelper
data.value: The role sets the permissions. Without a role the switches below apply.

data.name: OverrideRoleLabel
data.value: Set permissions differently from the role

data.name: RoleSummary
data.value: The role allows — write: {0} · export: {1} · import: {2} · modules: {3}

data.name: AdministratorHasAll
data.value: Administrators always have every permission — there is nothing to restrict here.

data.name: CanWriteHelper
data.value: Without this right the account is a reader: it can see everything but save or delete nothing.

data.name: ImportNeedsWriteHint
data.value: An import writes the whole content — without the write permission it stays blocked anyway.

data.name: ModulesHelper
data.value: Only these modules appear in the bar, the search and the pages. No selection counts as “all”.

data.name: PermissionsTakeEffectHint
data.value: Changed permissions apply from the user’s next sign-in.

data.name: DisabledHelper
data.value: Sign-in is refused; the account and its log entries remain.

data.name: ExternalIdHelper
data.value: Links this account to an external sign-in. The sign-in page shows the identifier when someone signs in externally without an account here.
